checks.note: Acme Fastening is called "a rival" and is never named. HomeMax is a customer, not a competitor, so naming it is fine.
Bullet 1 covers the 61% revenue concentration in two retailers and HomeMax's unrenewed contract expiring in Q1.
Bullet 2 covers the drop from 42% to 38% driven by steel costs. Bullets 3 and 4 tie it to the 36% covenant on the $20M credit line.
Every figure comes from the report. The '2-point cushion' is correctly derived (38% − 36%). 'Could force price matching' is a reasonable inference, not an invented fact.
